text: Hey so heres a real challenge probably, maybe not, but lets look at moment at our world values and how they were exposed to us inside of @cart/hmsc-int/ and how we currently lack this inside of @cart/editor/ ; ok now long story short those world values, the globals, whatever you want to call them, for physics, player speed, yada yada, we need to bring them over, but heres the monkey wrench, so as the interface right now stands, its a two route system, the play route and the editor route, the editor route is a huge state machine. this is where globals will lay. How i want it to work though is that ok so the world editor spawns a real birds eye view of the game world already. and we can interface with it this way its clear, so then its technically going to be possible for you to quite literally treat this feature to where i say click on (a non-existing file menu right now) and go Globals -> Physics for example, i want it to take this interface you see here [Image #3] and we are going to open a new tab of the world , with the player model, and to the focus panel we spawn the physics globals as settings and in real time i want to be able to adjust something like jump height and test it immediately, find a value, lock it in.

events.text: Claimed. Oracle consulted: V1 (physics = one host-side Zig system), V28 (game is data), R4 (scale contract). Plan: bring world globals (physics/player tunables) into cart/editor — new Globals menu in chrome, opens a playtest tab (world + player model), focus panel hosts live-adjustable settings (e.g. jump height) applied to the running sim in real time, lock-in persists. Exploring hmsc-int reference plumbing + editor shell architecture now.

Built the full slice. FRAMEWORK: world_loader.zig live physics override (pending-slot pattern; 13-float PHYSICS_CONFIG lump order; stepNow reads override orelse baked lump) + __compiled_world_set_physics/_clear_physics doors; blank/pre-lump worlds now synthesize a blocky stand-in player figure (R4 proportions) instead of 'camera target only'. EDITOR CART: Globals menu (data-driven: MENUS/COMMANDS/MENU_TREE) -> Physics opens a 'playtest' workspace tab (new WorkspaceDocumentKind) mounting the editor world EMBODIED (no external camera => loader's built-in WASD/Shift/Space player), fed the same live pieces/resident meshes via new shared world/livePush.ts; Inspector playtest branch = GLOBALS PHYSICS panel (13 tunables, OverrideField grid, groups from data/globals.ts, defaults = hmsc tuned values); edits push the door live, dispatch globals.set on the editorbus, micro-save to world-globals.json (worldStore pattern), reload at boot. Tests: globals.test.ts wire-contract (pack order) green; full cart bundles clean with production flags. SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ship editor running to verify the Zig.

resolution: Globals live in cart/editor: a new Globals menu (data-driven MENUS/COMMANDS/MENU_TREE) whose Physics entry opens a PLAYTEST workspace tab — the editor's own world mounted embodied (the loader's built-in WASD/Shift/Space third-person player; blank worlds get a synthesized stand-in figure per R4 proportions, world_loader fallbackPlayerModel). The focus panel on that tab is the physics-globals editor: 13 tunables (jump speed, gravity, walk/run, acceleration, friction, body radius/height, step height, wall/body/ground bounce, ledge grace) as OverrideField steppers grouped by data/globals.ts, defaults = the hmsc tuned feel. Every click pushes the new __compiled_world_set_physics door (13 floats, exact PHYSICS_CONFIG lump order — globals.test.ts locks the wire contract) and the NEXT physics step runs it; a globals.set event rides the editorbus; a debounced micro-save writes world-globals.json (worldStore contract) and boot reloads it — find a value, lock it in. Verified: ship clean, headless shot shows the Globals menu + embodied player; loader log shows the stand-in figure on the blank world.
